requirements.summary: Add frontend deployment readiness artifacts and runtime safeguards so the live storefront loads publicly without blank screens or console errors.
acceptanceCriteria: A live/public URL is available for the latest build.
Visiting the live URL loads the storefront without requiring authentication.
The deployed app renders without blank screens or console errors on initial load.

file_operations.description: Document the supported go-live process for this storefront (build, publish, and post-deploy validation checklist), explicitly calling out that the public storefront must be accessible without authentication and must not ship with initial-load console errors.

Add a static-host SPA fallback page to reduce blank screens on deep-link refreshes after deployment by redirecting/bootstrapping the app’s main entry when the host returns a 404 for client-side routes.
Create a lightweight React error boundary to catch unexpected render-time failures and show a non-blank fallback UI (instead of a blank screen) to satisfy initial-load robustness expectations.

Wire the new AppErrorBoundary around the routed application so unexpected runtime errors render a fallback instead of a blank screen; ensure existing global toaster remains available for user feedback.

requirements.summary: Ensure the Share button copies the correct live URL derived from the deployed environment (window.location.origin + window.location.pathname) and shows success/error toasts appropriately.
acceptanceCriteria: On the live deployment, clicking “Share” copies a URL that matches the current deployed origin and path.
The UI shows a success toast when copying succeeds and an error toast when copying fails.

file_operations.description: Harden the Share button behavior to consistently copy exactly window.location.origin + window.location.pathname in deployed environments and to reliably show success/error toast feedback. Use the existing shadcn-ui Button and sonner toast utilities already integrated in the app (verify the component's usage instructions before implementing).
Confirm the ShareButton remains present in the primary navigation and is not conditionally hidden in production builds, ensuring the live site can copy the correct deployed URL from any page.
